root_cause.text: In l2cap_conn_del(), cancel_delayed_work_sync() is called while holding conn->lock, but the deferred work functions (l2cap_info_timeout and l2cap_conn_update_id_addr) also acquire conn->lock, creating an AB-BA deadlock if the work is already executing.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "l2cap_conn_del() calls cancel_delayed_work_sync() for both info_timer and id_addr_timer while holding conn->lock. However, the work functions l2cap_info_timeout() and l2cap_conn_update_id_addr() both acquire conn->lock, creating a potential AB-BA deadlock if the work is already executing when l2cap_conn_del() takes the lock." The patch moves the disable/cancellation calls before acquiring conn->lock.

bic_trace_step.reason: In l2cap_conn_del(), mutex_lock(&conn->lock) is acquired at the start, and later cancel_delayed_work_sync(&conn->info_timer) is called while the lock is still held. The deferred work functions l2cap_info_timeout and l2cap_conn_update_id_addr also acquire conn->lock, creating a classic deadlock scenario if the work is already executing. This commit does not introduce any mitigation for this deadlock; it only renames the mutex and moves hci_chan_del inside the locked section. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present and not fixed.

Author: Vinicius Costa Gomes <vinicius.gomes@openbossa.org>
Date:   Tue Jun 14 13:37:41 2011 -0300

    Bluetooth: Add support for SMP timeout
    
    This patch adds support for disconnecting the link when SMP procedure
    takes more than 30 seconds.
    
    SMP begins when either the Pairing Request command is sent or the
    Pairing Response is received, and it ends when the link is encrypted
    (or terminated). Vol 3, Part H Section 3.4.
bic_trace_step.reason: The code shown uses timers (del_timer_sync, del_timer) instead of delayed work, and l2cap_conn_del does not acquire any lock (like conn->lock) before deleting timers. The root cause describes a deadlock with cancel_delayed_work_sync while holding conn->lock, which is absent here. Therefore, the vulnerable construct is not present.
